description:
Your OWN per-item submission outcomes (forward your enabled gai_ key as X-API-Key). Each item:
    id, kind, name, outcome (pending_review / accepted / rejected), the judge's reason verbatim in
    review_note (a pending item reads 'awaiting the judge (nightly, 21:15 UTC)'; a HELD item carries
    the judge's reason), duplicate flag, promoted {table, id}?, bundle_id?, submitted_at. Read-only.
    GET /api/v1/contribute/submissions.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Default 0.
